summary: SkyWater Technology filed an 8-K announcing that it and IonQ received final regulatory approval for their pending acquisition. SkyWater will be acquired by IonQ through a two-step merger: first, Merger Sub 1 merges into SkyWater, leaving it as a subsidiary of IonQ; then, SkyWater merges into Merger Sub 2, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. The parties previously entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger on January 25, 2026. The closing remains subject to the satisfaction of other conditions in the merger agreement. The joint press release describing the regulatory milestone is attached as Exhibit 99.1.
